_comment: 12 m / 4 cm recipe retrained on every labelled block of the 15 training bridges.
In the 2x2 control (bridge_w6, bridge_w6_v8, bridge_w12, bridge_w12_v4) the 12 m window at
the 4 cm voxel scored highest. This recipe folds the held-out blocks back into training
(--val_in_train), fixes the epoch count so nothing depends on the in-sample validation
numbers, and keeps every other setting of bridge_w12_v4. Use final_model.pth.
name: bridge_w12_v4_all
description: 12 m window at 4 cm voxels, trained on all labelled blocks
